easierVariant.description: Reduce workout sets of the resistance moves to 2 sets for managing soft tissue load.
modifications: Moderate posture depths if joints feel tight.

harderVariant.description: Increase dynamic repetitions to 15 per set or hold static planks for 60s.

Use cushion matting for knee security as prescribed.
